admins.title: Authorized Admins
admins.description: Authorized administrators for the Artist Portal

addedAt.description: ISO timestamp when admin was added

addedBy.description: Email of the admin who granted access

inquiries.title: Client Inquiries
inquiries.description: Client inquiries submitted via the Contact form

message.description: Inquiry message or mehndi request details

status.description: Current status of the client inquiry

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of submission date and time

bookings.title: Booking Requests
bookings.description: Mehndi booking requests submitted via the Booking modal

/admins/{adminEmail}.rules: allow read: if request.auth != null && (request.auth.token.email == adminEmail || isOwner()); allow write: if isOwner();

/inquiries/{inquiryId}.rules: allow create: if true; allow read, update, delete: if isAuthorizedAdmin();

/bookings/{bookingId}.rules: allow create: if true; allow read, update, delete: if isAuthorizedAdmin();
